experiences.config:
env:
  seed: 45
  device: cuda
  gpu_id: 4
  gpu_memory_limit_mib: 40000
  gpu_reserve_cache: true
  preload_gpu: true
data:
  data_dir: <DATA_DIR>
  val_split: 0.12
  batch_size: 32
  num_workers: 4
  pin_memory: true
  drop_last: false
  dataset: slicewise
  preprocess: normalize_b0_mean
  orientation: axial
  augment:
  - name: flip_x
    p: 0.5
  - name: flip_y
    p: 0.5
  - name: rot180
    p: 0.25
model:
  name: spatial
  spatial:
    use_KAN: false
    use_VAE: false
    encoder:
      type: UNet
      hidden: 96
      num_layers: 4
      use_gn: true
      residual: true
      dilation: 1
      stride: 1
      attention:
        enabled: true
        reduction: 16
        kernel_size: 7
        use_channel_attn: true
        use_spatial_attn: true
    decoder:
      hidden: 288
      num_layers: 5
      neck: 96
      dropout: 0.005
training:
  epochs: 420
  lr: 0.00024
  log_every: 1
  ckpt_every: 5
  grad_clip: 0.8
  optimizer:
    name: adamw
    adam:
      weight_decay: 0.0
    adamw:
      weight_decay: 0.0002
    sgd:
      momentum: 0.9
      weight_decay: 0.0
  scheduler:
    name: warmup_plateau
    warmup_plateau:
      warmup_epochs: 14
      mode: min
      factor: 0.5
      patience: 14
      min_lr: 7.5e-07
      eta_min: 0.0
    plateau:
      mode: min
      factor: 0.5
      patience: 14
      min_lr: 7.5e-07
    cosine_warmup:
      warmup_epochs: 14
      T_max: 420
      eta_min: 7.5e-07
      last_epoch: -1
    cosine:
      T_max: 420
      eta_min: 7.5e-07
    step:
      step_size: 45
      gamma: 0.5
    exponential:
      gamma: 0.97
    cosine_warm_restart:
      T_0: 70
      T_mult: 2
      eta_min: 7.5e-07
      warmup_epochs: 14
  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 75
    min_delta: 7.5e-07
loss:
  data_consistency:
    shell_weighting: manual
    shell_weights:
    - 1.8
    - 1.0
    MSE:
      weight: 1.0
    MAE:
      weight: 0.02
    Huber:
      weight: 0.06
      beta: 0.04
    SSIM:
      weight: 0.01
    Rician:
      weight: 0.1
      s_noise: auto
  KL:
    weight: 0.0
    beta: 1.0
  parameter_map:
    TV:
      weight: 0.012
    CoordGradL2:
      weight: 0.0
      normalize: true
      weights: []
    CoordFiniteDiffL2:
      weight: 0.0
      eps: 0.005
      normalize: true
      weights: []
    CoordBending:
      weight: 0.0
      normalize: true
      weights: []
physics:
  name: DTI
  constrain_weight: 0
